note: Hebrew levo chamat ("the entrance of Hamath") is now generally taken as a place name, Lebo(-hamath), in the Beqaa valley, rather than a description of the route.

kjv: the giants, the sons of Anak, [which come] of the giants
mine: the Nephilim (the sons of Anak are from the Nephilim)
note: Hebrew nephilim is a proper term (cf. Gen 6:4) of uncertain meaning; the KJV follows the Septuagint gigantes. The parenthesis linking Anakim to Nephilim is part of the spies' exaggeration. Context: the Nephilim, seen as giants (medium confidence). The spies add 'we seemed like grasshoppers': the name carries a sense of enormous size in their exaggerated report.
